step.cmd: Open Microsoft Word and launch the X-Author for Contracts Advanced add-in.
Log in to X-Author for Contracts.
In the Contracts pane, go to Work > Clause Library.
Highlight the content of the contract to be marked as a clause.
Search the clause you want to add or select the clause from the available clauses list and click the More icon() next to the clause name.

info.p: By marking the text as a clause in your contract document, the text adopts the properties of the marked clause. You can even choose to replace the text in the contract with text from a pre-existing clause in your Clause Library. When the contract document is checked in and reconciled to the contract record, information on marked clauses is added to the Contract Clauses related list.

note.p: Clauses can only be smart in the context of single generated or offline contract document. You cannot select more than 32000 characters for marking a clause.
